newsitem.title: DENMARK: Superfos says will not raise Phoenix bid.
newsitem.headline: Superfos says will not raise Phoenix bid.

text.p: Danish construction company Superfos, one of three bidders for roadbuilder Phoenix Contractors, said on Thursday that it did not intend to raise its offer.
Superfos, the favoured bidder of Phoenix's institutional shareholders, is offering 808 million Danish crowns for the company.
Norway's Rieber and Son has bid 820 million and is the favoured suitor of Phoenix staff and some smaller shareholders.
A third bidder, Marius Pedersen has said it will not raise its offer of 776 million crowns.
The latest date for further bids is March 7. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
